Sam (Design): Quick UX pass — when I drag to change rule priority the preview timeline 'stutters' and sometimes the highlighted sample routes disappear. GIF: https://imgur.com/xxxx Did anyone else see this?

Ava (Product): Saw that too on staging. Steps: open policy editor, set 6 rules, enable sim, drag rule 4->1. Preview rebuilds & briefly shows blank heatmap.

Raj (Eng): That's the re-render problem — preview recomputes from scratch on order change. Adding debounce + incremental apply might help. Stack trace from console:
```
preview.update(): fullRecompute() -> renderHeatmap()
```

Maya (DevEx): Could we at least show a skeleton or 'updating...' overlay? Users think it's broken. Also microcopy tweak: 'Preview is recalculating' vs current 'Simulating...' seems clearer.

Ava (Product): Agree on overlay. Also validation thing: when two rules have identical priority we show 'Duplicate priority' banner that reads 'error'. Can we rephrase to 'Conflicting priorities — order will determine precedence'? Less scary.

Sam (Design): Propose small chip label change in ordering UI: show a faint 'priority 1' badge and on hover show 'Pinned by user' or 'Calculated by system'.

Raj (Eng): Implementation notes: we currently compute priority key based on list index. Tie-breakers are naive. Could expose explicit 'pin' flag per rule to avoid accidental reorder. Backend needs minor schema bump: add pinned:boolean default false.

Maya (DevEx): Accessibility nit: when reordering via keyboard the live region announces 'Moved' but not the new index. Should be 'Moved to position 1 of 6'. Also need focus management — focus should follow the moved item.

Ava (Product): Ok action items: Raj to prototype debounce + overlay; Sam to mock badge + updated hover copy; Maya to write ARIA change; I'll update product note. Any objections?

Raj (Eng): Fine. Quick snippet I'll try:
```
const applyOrder = debounce(() => recomputePreview({ incremental: true }), 200)
```
trying incremental recompute first.

Sam (Design): Small visual: reduced motion when preview refreshes? currently it's jumpy. Maybe fade rather than slide. :eyes:

Jenkins Bot: Deploy queued for staging: inference-preview-fix #7421 — build 392 queued by @raj. ETA ~10m

Ava (Product): Thanks everyone. I'll post a follow-up once Raj has a staging shim. :thumbsup:
